test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the following information and answer the question that follows.

(i) Five ladies Simran, Vaishali, Namita, Preeti, and Bhawna meet in a hotel for a party. They all sit around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

(ii) Bhawna is sitting to the right of Vaishali.

(iii) Simran is sitting to the left of Preeti.

(iv) Preeti is sitting between Namita and Simran.

Who is sitting to the right of Namita?
solution:
Five ladies Simran, Vaishali, Namita, Preeti, and Bhawna meet in a hotel for a party. They all sit around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

(i) Simran is sitting to the left of Preeti.

(ii) Preeti is sitting between Namita and Simran.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27aa49784e0693384bda393b5e8eaf87ab1bd53a3bd08b504890c8f8b72f138f.png] 

(iii) Bhawna is sitting to the right of Vaishali.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/226e6a03af73cc6ccbaebe31a020eeed7768590bd9f3ac0aa351680b54db8cef.png] 

Clearly, Vaishali is sitting to the right of Namita.

Hence, ‘**Vaishali**’ is the correct answer.
